marcus-people: Quick one  employee Mia had a family bereavement in Dec and used 2 sick days + 1 PTO day during the week of Dec 21. Her year-end PTO resets on Jan 1 and blackout is Dec 20Dec 31. Manager asked if we can: (A) convert the sick days to bereavement so they don't hit her sick bank, (B) allow 1 PTO day to carry into Jan because she couldn't use it, or (C) payout the PTO. What's the right process?

ellen-hrbp: Short answer: bereavement has its own policy (see handbook). If the absence qualifies as bereavement, we can reclassify eligible sick/PTO to bereavement with documentation. Carryover of PTO across year-end needs People Ops + Manager sign-off; payouts are last resort and require Finance approval.

jared-manager: Manager here. Mia went home for funeral and provided a funeral notice. She was out Dec 2122 and had planned PTO for Dec 23 (but cancelled travel). Happy to document. Would prefer not to reduce her sick bank.

sophie-benefits: We can reclassify the two sick days to bereavement if document provided. For the 1 PTO day: options: 1) carryover as 1 exception (requires People Ops + Manager + Finance if it changes accruals), 2) convert PTO to unpaid and mark as accommodation, or 3) one-time payout. Given year-end blackout, we need sign-off before fiscal close.

jon-payroll: Operational note: For reclassification we need a simple CSV entry to adjust codes:

```
worker_id, action, date_from, date_to, pay_code, note
55433, RECLASSIFY, 2026-12-21, 2026-12-22, BEREAVEMENT, "reclassify sick to bereavement per docs"
```

For PTO carryover or payout, payroll needs either an ACCRUAL_ADJ entry or a PTO_PAYOUT entry. Examples:

```
55433, ACCRUAL_ADJ, 1, "year-end carryover exception"
55433, PTO_PAYOUT, 1, "one-time payout for unused PTO"
```

Email payroll@redwood.com with CSV and cc people-ops + finance. Deadline for year-end accounting is 2026-12-18 for payouts.

marcus-people: Mia uploaded funeral notice to the HR portal and manager confirmed in DM. Can Ellen file the People Ops exception and advise Finance?

ellen-hrbp: I'll open ticket HR-2099 and attach docs. I'll request a 1-day carryover exception and ask Finance to approve for accrual accounting. If Finance denies we'll fallback to payout; Jon, please flag if we need the CSV earlier.

jon-payroll: Noted. If Finance gives conditional approval, payroll can hold the adjustment until we get the final sign-off but we need the CSV by 2026-12-18 to guarantee processing before close.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout 2026-12-20 to 2026-12-31. Exceptions require Manager + People Ops approval; payouts must follow Finance deadlines.

jared-manager: Confirming I approve the carryover exception for Mia pending People Ops + Finance. I've added a note in the team calendar about coverage for her Jan dates.

marcus-people: Thanks everyone. Ellen: please update this thread when HR ticket is created and when Finance responds. Mia: we've got you covered 44D
